async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'technology' category link to navigate to a page that might contain the Archives widget
    # Use get_by_role with exact name matching to avoid ambiguity
    technology_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="technology", exact=True)
    await technology_link.first.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now, on the new page, look for the 'Archives' widget and click 'April 2023' link
    # First, check if there is a complementary or aside section that might contain Archives
    # Assuming Archives widget is in a complementary or region with role="complementary" or similar
    # Look for a widget with name containing 'Archives' (case-insensitive)
    archives_widget = page.get_by_role("region").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Archives", exact=False))
    if await archives_widget.count() > 0:
        # Within the archives widget, find the link for 'April 2023'
        april_2023_link = archives_widget.get_by_role("link", name="April 2023", exact=True)
        await april_2023_link.click()
    else:
        # If no Archives widget found, try looking in other common areas like aside or navigation
        aside_widget = page.get_by_role("complementary").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Archives", exact=False))
        if await aside_widget.count() > 0:
            april_2023_link = aside_widget.get_by_role("link", name="April 2023", exact=True)
            await april_2023_link.click()
        else:
            # If still not found, print a message and return
            print("Archives widget not found on the current page.")
    # Wait for any subsequent navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
